mcqs.q: Is the result of 6 / 0.5 larger or smaller than 6?
options: Smaller, because division always makes numbers smaller.
3/5 is larger because fractions are always smaller-looking but bigger.
Larger — dividing by a number less than 1 gives a bigger result (6 / 0.5 = 12).
Equal to 6, because 0.5 is half and so cancels out.

mcqs.q: Is the result of 8 x 0.4 larger or smaller than 8?
options: Larger, because multiplying always makes numbers bigger.
Smaller — multiplying by a number between 0 and 1 makes the result smaller (the answer is 3.2).
The same as 8, because 0.4 is too small to change anything.
Equal to 6, because 0.5 is half and so cancels out.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Simplify”?
options: Same bottom number used to combine fractions.
Divide top and bottom by their HCF.
Same value written with different numbers.
Numerator bigger than denominator.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Improper fraction”?
options: A whole plus a fraction, like 1 1/2.
Numerator bigger than denominator.
Divide top and bottom by their HCF.
Same bottom number used to combine fractions.
